+### Historical 2026-09-27 toolchain disposition
+
+`runtime-toolchain-disposition-2026-09-27.json` records the superseded,
+unqualified disposition of the historical Aspire SDK split: the tuple names
+13.5.4, while audited AppHosts include both 13.5.3 and 13.5.4. The separate
+annotation binds the immutable baseline's normalized-LF SHA-256 (CRLF checkouts
+retain the same digest); it does not amend its
+approval or qualify the split, runtime, package adoption, deployment or release.
+Historical containment holds remain active. Lowercase `dapr` means runtime/.NET
+support-table metadata with an explicit historical exception; uppercase `Dapr`
+means the catalog package identity, recorded as not activated. They are distinct
+case-sensitive keys, not contradictory qualification claims.

+python3 Tools/validate-runtime-toolchain-disposition.py
+python3 Tools/test-runtime-toolchain-disposition.py
+python3 Tools/test-runtime-toolchain-evidence-validator.py

+        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPT)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
+        self.assertIn("SDK split unqualified", result.stdout)
+
+    def test_crlf_equivalent_historical_checkout_retains_normalized_digest(self):
+        baseline = SCRIPT.with_name(VALIDATOR.BASELINE_NAME)
+        disposition = SCRIPT.with_name("runtime-toolchain-disposition-2026-09-27.json")
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch:
+            crlf = Path(scratch) / VALIDATOR.BASELINE_NAME
+            crlf.write_bytes(baseline.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n").replace(b"\n", b"\r\n"))
+            VALIDATOR.validate(disposition, crlf)
+            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPT), "--baseline", str(crlf)],
+                                    capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
+
+    def test_rejects_mutations_without_changing_historical_bytes(self):
+        source = SCRIPT.with_name("runtime-toolchain-disposition-2026-09-27.json")
+        original = json.loads(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        mutations = [

+            ("baseline path", lambda d: d["historicalBaseline"].update(path="../other.json")),
+            ("qualified status", lambda d: d.update(status="qualified")),

+            ("tuple rewrite", lambda d: d["aspireSdkSplit"].update(tupleSdk="13.5.3")),
+            ("hidden split", lambda d: d["aspireSdkSplit"].update(auditedAppHostSdks=["13.5.4"])),
+            ("runtime qualification", lambda d: d["qualification"].update(runtimeQualified=True)),
+            ("package qualification", lambda d: d["qualification"].update(packageAdoptionQualified=True)),
+            ("invented approval", lambda d: d.update(approvedBy="invented")),
+            ("support meaning", lambda d: d["daprMeanings"]["dapr"].update(meaning="catalog-package-identity")),
+            ("catalog meaning", lambda d: d["daprMeanings"]["Dapr"].update(meaning="runtime-dotnet-support-table-metadata")),
+            ("catalog activation", lambda d: d["daprMeanings"]["Dapr"].update(historicalDecision="activated")),

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Validate the separate, unqualified disposition of the immutable 2026-09-27 baseline."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+BASELINE_NAME = "runtime-toolchain-baseline-2026-09-27.json"
+BASELINE_SHA256 = "b9aa6791effe78cbb9bf405cd8384b81a6d750f996fabf8f79b7cd1c3bedad01"
+
+
+def read_json(path: Path) -> dict:
+    """Reject duplicate JSON keys as well as malformed documents."""
+    def unique(pairs: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> dict:
+        result = {}
+        for key, value in pairs:
+            if key in result:
+                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate JSON key: {key}")
+            result[key] = value
+        return result
+
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=unique)
+
+
+def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
+    if not condition:
+        raise ValueError(message)
+
+
+def fields(value: object, names: set[str], label: str) -> dict:
+    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == names, f"{label} fields drift")
+    return value
+
+
+def validate(disposition_path: Path, baseline_path: Path) -> None:
+    """Require the pinned normalized-LF digest and reject new qualification or approval."""
+    require(hashlib.sha256(baseline_path.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == BASELINE_SHA256,
+            "Historical baseline SHA-256 drift")
+    baseline = read_json(baseline_path)
+    disposition = fields(read_json(disposition_path), {
+        "schema", "historicalBaseline", "status", "aspireSdkSplit", "daprMeanings",
+        "qualification", "containment",
+    }, "Disposition")
+    require(disposition["schema"] == "hexalith.runtime-toolchain-disposition.v1", "Schema drift")
+    binding = fields(disposition["historicalBaseline"], {"path", "sha256"}, "Baseline binding")
+    require(binding == {"path": BASELINE_NAME, "sha256": BASELINE_SHA256}, "Baseline binding drift")
+    require(disposition["status"] == "superseded-unqualified", "Historical status cannot qualify the split")
+    split = fields(disposition["aspireSdkSplit"], {
+        "tupleSdk", "auditedAppHostSdks", "disposition", "qualified",
+    }, "Aspire SDK split")
+    observed = sorted({pin["version"] for pin in baseline["pinAudit"]["appHostProjects"]})
+    require(split["tupleSdk"] == baseline["tuple"]["aspireSdk"]
+            and split["auditedAppHostSdks"] == observed and len(observed) > 1,
+            "Aspire SDK split does not match historical evidence")
+    require(split["disposition"] == "superseded-without-split-qualification"
+            and split["qualified"] is False, "Aspire SDK split is unqualified")
+    meanings = fields(disposition["daprMeanings"], {"dapr", "Dapr"}, "Dapr meanings")
+    require(meanings["dapr"] == {
+        "meaning": "runtime-dotnet-support-table-metadata",
+        "historicalDecision": baseline["dispositions"]["dapr"]["decision"],
+    }, "Lowercase dapr must retain its support-table meaning")
+    require(meanings["Dapr"] == {
+        "meaning": "catalog-package-identity",
+        "historicalDecision": baseline["dispositions"]["Dapr"],
+    }, "Uppercase Dapr must retain its catalog-package meaning")
+    qualification = fields(disposition["qualification"], {
+        "runtimeQualified", "packageAdoptionQualified",
+    }, "Qualification")
+    require(all(value is False for value in qualification.values()), "No qualification is granted")
+    containment = fields(disposition["containment"], set(baseline["containment"]), "Containment")
+    require(all(value is False for value in containment.values()), "Historical release holds remain active")
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--disposition", type=Path,
+                        default=Path(__file__).with_name("runtime-toolchain-disposition-2026-09-27.json"))
+    parser.add_argument("--baseline", type=Path, default=Path(__file__).with_name(BASELINE_NAME))
+    arguments = parser.parse_args()
+    try:
+        validate(arguments.disposition, arguments.baseline)
+    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
+        print(f"RUNTIME-TOOLCHAIN-DISPOSITION-INVALID: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    print("RUNTIME-TOOLCHAIN-DISPOSITION-VALID: superseded; SDK split unqualified; release holds preserved")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())"}]}

+
+SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name("validate-runtime-toolchain-disposition.py")
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("disposition_validator", SCRIPT)
+VALIDATOR = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(VALIDATOR)
+
+
+class DispositionTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_historical_disposition_and_cli(self):
+        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPT)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
+        self.assertIn("SDK split unqualified", result.stdout)
+
+    def test_crlf_equivalent_historical_checkout_retains_normalized_digest(self):
+        baseline = SCRIPT.with_name(VALIDATOR.BASELINE_NAME)
+        disposition = SCRIPT.with_name("runtime-toolchain-disposition-2026-09-27.json")
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch:
+            crlf = Path(scratch) / VALIDATOR.BASELINE_NAME
+            crlf.write_bytes(baseline.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n").replace(b"\n", b"\r\n"))
+            VALIDATOR.validate(disposition, crlf)
+            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPT), "--baseline", str(crlf)],

+            ("runtime qualification", lambda d: d["qualification"].update(runtimeQualified=True)),
+            ("package qualification", lambda d: d["qualification"].update(packageAdoptionQualified=True)),
+            ("invented approval", lambda d: d.update(approvedBy="invented")),
+            ("support meaning", lambda d: d["daprMeanings"]["dapr"].update(meaning="catalog-package-identity")),

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Validate the separate, unqualified disposition of the immutable 2026-09-27 baseline."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+BASELINE_NAME = "runtime-toolchain-baseline-2026-09-27.json"
+BASELINE_SHA256 = "b9aa6791effe78cbb9bf405cd8384b81a6d750f996fabf8f79b7cd1c3bedad01"
+
+
+def read_json(path: Path) -> dict:
+    """Reject duplicate JSON keys as well as malformed documents."""
+    def unique(pairs: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> dict:
+        result = {}
+        for key, value in pairs:
+            if key in result:
+                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate JSON key: {key}")
+            result[key] = value
+        return result
+
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=unique)
+
+
+def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
+    if not condition:
+        raise ValueError(message)
+
+
+def fields(value: object, names: set[str], label: str) -> dict:
+    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == names, f"{label} fields drift")
+    return value
+
+
+def validate(disposition_path: Path, baseline_path: Path) -> None:
+    """Require the pinned normalized-LF digest and reject new qualification or approval."""
+    require(hashlib.sha256(baseline_path.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == BASELINE_SHA256,
+            "Historical baseline SHA-256 drift")
+    baseline = read_json(baseline_path)
+    disposition = fields(read_json(disposition_path), {
+        "schema", "historicalBaseline", "status", "aspireSdkSplit", "daprMeanings",
+        "qualification", "containment",
+    }, "Disposition")
+    require(disposition["schema"] == "hexalith.runtime-toolchain-disposition.v1", "Schema drift")
+    binding = fields(disposition["historicalBaseline"], {"path", "sha256"}, "Baseline binding")
+    require(binding == {"path": BASELINE_NAME, "sha256": BASELINE_SHA256}, "Baseline binding drift")
+    require(disposition["status"] == "superseded-unqualified", "Historical status cannot qualify the split")
+    split = fields(disposition["aspireSdkSplit"], {
+        "tupleSdk", "auditedAppHostSdks", "disposition", "qualified",
+    }, "Aspire SDK split")
+    observed = sorted({pin["version"] for pin in baseline["pinAudit"]["appHostProjects"]})
+    require(split["tupleSdk"] == baseline["tuple"]["aspireSdk"]
+            and split["auditedAppHostSdks"] == observed and len(observed) > 1,
+            "Aspire SDK split does not match historical evidence")
+    require(split["disposition"] == "superseded-without-split-qualification"
+            and split["qualified"] is False, "Aspire SDK split is unqualified")
+    meanings = fields(disposition["daprMeanings"], {"dapr", "Dapr"}, "Dapr meanings")
+    require(meanings["dapr"] == {
+        "meaning": "runtime-dotnet-support-table-metadata",
